faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Check your questions one by one, just like cases.

items.question: What kind of QA tool is testea?
items.answer: testea is a free QA tool where you write test cases, run them, and track results in one place. Manage your test documents in an organized way instead of spreadsheets.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes, it is free. Create a project and manage test cases right away, with no sign-up.

items.question: How is it different from other QA tools?
items.answer: You can use it right away without complex setup. Writing cases, running them, and tracking results flow together, so QA work gets done fast.

items.question: Why do I need test management?
items.answer: Documenting cases and tracking run results helps you catch bugs early and keep the same quality every release.

items.question: Can AI create test scenarios?
items.answer: Add your requirements and it drafts an analysis and test scenarios. You can turn the drafts into suites and cases right away.

items.question: Can I manage tests by requirement?
items.answer: Group scenarios and cases by feature (requirement) and track which requirements have been verified.
